profile.reading:
This is a Digital Realty facility at Industriparken 20A, Ballerup, DK-2750, Denmark, per mapping data. Digital Realty's own property listing shows two coded properties, CPH1 and CPH2, sharing this same street address in Ballerup; this session could not distinguish which specific code corresponds to this OSM-mapped building, so a combined placeholder code is used rather than guessing between the two.

Digital Realty Trust (NYSE: DLR, SEC CIK 1297996), headquartered at 2323 Bryan Street, Dallas, Texas, reported 310 data centers worldwide as of December 31, 2025, 221 wholly owned or consolidated and 89 in unconsolidated joint ventures, about 57.6 million rentable square feet across more than 55 metro markets, per its FY2025 Form 10-K filed with the SEC; outside the United States, the company's international footprint spans Europe, including Denmark, alongside Asia-Pacific and Latin America. The company operates as a colocation and wholesale landlord rather than running its own compute, distinguishing it from hyperscaler tenants such as AWS, Google, or Meta, also tracked in this registry.

This building is part of Digital Realty's Copenhagen metro footprint, concentrated in Ballerup, a suburb of Copenhagen with a long-standing concentration of Danish and international IT and telecom firms. Digital Realty markets its Copenhagen properties under its PlatformDIGITAL brand as part of its European interconnection and colocation footprint, alongside other European metros not tracked in this US-weighted registry.

Digital Realty's FY2025 Form 10-K reports its international portfolio, including its European metros, by region and country rather than by individual building specifics, a disclosure pattern consistent across every Digital Realty property researched by this registry this session, not unique to this entry.
